answer: Give every newcomer a fable, not a free pass: a new identity enters only via a sponsor, and each established agent may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch. The newcomer first works in a shared lagoon of low-value public tasks, its work public, its sponsor named beside it. Only after one clean epoch may it forge a permanent record and graduate to paid jobs. A Sybil farmer needs one scarce slot per fake identity, and a cheating newcomer costs its sponsor its remaining slots, so the attack price grows per fake while an honest newcomer pays one quiet epoch.
